# AntennaPod+

AntennaPod+ is an **unofficial** personal modification of [AntennaPod](https://github.com/AntennaPod/AntennaPod), the open-source podcast app for Android. It adds saved playlists beside AntennaPod's single queue.

> **Not supported by the AntennaPod team.** Please don't report AntennaPod+ problems on AntennaPod's forum or bug tracker. If you want the official app, get [AntennaPod](https://github.com/AntennaPod/AntennaPod) instead.

- **Download:** signed APKs are on the [releases page](https://github.com/rzrogers/AntennaPod/releases). Each release links to the exact commit it was built from. AntennaPod+ is not published on any app store.
- **What's different from AntennaPod:** see [ANTENNAPOD-PLUS.md](../ANTENNAPOD-PLUS.md).
- **Source code:** this repository. AntennaPod+ work is on the `playlists` branch; `develop` is an unmodified copy of official AntennaPod.
- **License:** GNU General Public License, version 3, the same as AntennaPod. See [LICENSE](../LICENSE).

All credit for AntennaPod itself goes to the [AntennaPod contributors](https://github.com/AntennaPod/AntennaPod/graphs/contributors).
